Reviewed head: `8ce7f2dbb1b7dcc45a727d4b2c7e9d147d93a766`. Trial merge with upstream/main `d94c65fcfb9810036bfbe86bd18467b9d20f64a9`: clean (local merge commit `bd3a9f62b`, HEAD^1 is the PR head). GitHub says `MERGEABLE`.

## What looks good

- With no pick, the application calls the old arms. `pocket3d_picked` with an empty seam is `run_plain_with` with the same arguments (`picks: None` at each old caller of `ladder`). The arm for "Do not touch" items does the same `elevate_rapid_links` step as `pocket3d_avoid` and `pocket3d_open_avoid`.
- The seat runs on `LevelPlan.passes` immediately after `plan_level`, before the ladder reads the passes. Thus the entry rule, the keep-down proof (`chord_clears`, `chord_hits_plan`) and the links all read the seated passes. `joins` and `air_entry` are set only by the HSM plan, and the seat refuses an HSM level (`lp.hsm || lp.arcs.is_some()`), so no stale join or air entry can ride a moved start.
- Ring passes are never reversed, and the passes are never re-ordered. A run-on re-traces a cut at the same depth in the same direction. Only open zigzag chains reverse.
- Refusals are by name: start reach, descent reach, exit reach, an HSM level, and (at the command doors and at project load, through `named_refusal`) Adaptive and Rest roughing.
- The column law is exact (clip to the half-space above the foot, then `dist_seg_tri`). A NaN distance is a hit.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in new non-test code. Each new module has a provenance line. New files are under 400 lines; `ladder.rs` gets smaller (444 to 441). `mask_center` moves to `rest.rs` unchanged.
- No new crate edge (`camcraft_sim` is already a dependency of `camcraft-motion`). No goldens, recorded programs, snapshot PNGs, process files, `Cargo.*`, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` in the diff. "Goldens moved: None" is correct.
- No `crates/ui` change, so no screenshots are necessary.
- The body has the mutation table, the readings, the pinning tests, `Changelog:` and `Refs #3329` (a partial slice). The decision record is `docs/decisions/3329-pocket3d-picks.md`.

## Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups, suggested P7)

1. `crates/motion/src/machining3d/level_seam.rs:292`: the HSM-level refusal text has a run of about 14 spaces in it ("its own              entry bore"). A source line wrap lost its `\` continuation. The message is correct but looks broken. Fix: put `\` at the end of the first part, as the other messages in this file do.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1367`: the picked arm comes before the arms that read `rest_rough`. With a pick and Rest roughing on, this arm would drop the rest pass silently. Today no caller can get there: `named_refusal` refuses the pair at create, at edit and at project load. A second check in the arm (as the Bore arm has at `generate.rs:3164`, "for a project file or a caller that skipped them") would make it defence in depth: return `pocket3d_pick_refusal` as a `GenError::Invalid` before `pocket3d_picked`.
